hackathon_name: Hacktoberfest Open-Source AI Challenge — Week 4: Ghost in the Machine

roster_audit.not_discoverable_reason: DEV challenge gallery is not public until after the Oct-31 deadline; only indirect signals (public posts under the hf26challenge tag) are visible pre-deadline. Standalone-fresh concept makes roster scouting low-value. Competitor signal captured in research-brief Competitor Landscape instead.

submission_requirements: Published DEV post using the official submission template
New open-source AI project created+completed within the challenge window (no pre-existing code, no PRs to existing projects)
How I Built It (which open-source AI tools used)
Optional: My Agent Session (DevRelay embed), The Spirit of It, Prize Categories
required_integrations: open-source AI at the core (open-weight model OR OSS agent harness OR local inference)

demo_video_requirements.content_notes: Deployed link OR video demo required. No length cap published. Winners 2x more likely to embed a demo video (42% vs 21%). GIF/video strongly recommended.

disqualifiers: Project/repo not created+completed within the challenge window (pre-existing code = ineligible)
PRs to existing projects (not accepted — must be a brand-new project)
More than one entry (only the FIRST entry submitted is judged)
Core AI not open-source (a closed model as the core, with no open-weight/OSS-harness/local-inference, fails the prompt)

sponsor_bounties.requirements: Use Render as the AI runtime, agent frontend host, or to run Hermes/OpenClaw
sponsor_bounties.integration_depth_bar: Render must host the live, functioning app — a deployed public URL that works during the judging window

sponsor_bounties.requirements: Use TabPFN (tabular foundation model) to forecast/predict/classify/spot-anomalies from historical tabular data; TabPFN-3.5 recommended; favored INSIDE a wider prediction agent
sponsor_bounties.integration_depth_bar: TabPFN is load-bearing for a real tabular prediction, not a bolt-on

network.deploy_requirement: Render-hosted live URL for the Render category; durable (non-ephemeral) tier so it survives the judging window

judges: Partner reps (Render, Prior Labs) for partner categories

tools: claude-in-chrome (publish to dev.to via Dami's logged-in session)
ANTHROPIC/FAL/ELEVENLABS keys available (NOT core — core must be open-source AI)

judge_reading: DEV editorial team scores the OVERALL prize and they reward the POST as a craft object — long, structured, cover-imaged, demo-video'd, first-person build-story. Partner categories (Render, Prior Labs) are judged by sponsor engineers who reward load-bearing, non-bolt-on integration. The post is the product; the app is the evidence.
